description: Test requests for AI-guided hero discovery conversation flow

endpoints.name: START - Initialize discovery session
endpoints.description: Start a new discovery session with AI-generated opening greeting and question

source_experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
source_experience.summary: Led engineering team for customer-facing products and infrastructure
highlights: Rebuilt legacy systems to modern stack

expected_response.ai_message:
Hi Sarah! I'm going to help you identify 3-5 career achievements from your role as a Senior Software Engineer at TechCorp. These will be great for your resume, LinkedIn, and interview prep.

Looking at your background rebuilding legacy systems and leading the team—what specific achievement from that work are you most proud of?

endpoints.notes: Returns 201 Created. session_id is used in continue and end endpoints.

endpoints.name: CONTINUE - Process user message and identify moments
endpoints.description: Continue conversation, identify moments, ask follow-ups. Pass user_message, session_id, and captured_moments array. Conversation history is automatically retrieved from database.

request.user_message: I rebuilt our customer portal. It was really old and slow, causing tons of support tickets.

expected_response.ai_message: A portal rebuild sounds significant! What was challenging about that project?

endpoints.name: CONTINUE - Capture moment when ready
endpoints.description: AI captures moment after getting enough detail (title + what they did + result), then pivots to new achievement

request.user_message: The challenge was it was built 10 years ago and we were getting 200 support tickets a week. I was the lead engineer. I rebuilt it using React and AWS, and we got tickets down to 110 per week.

expected_response.ai_message:
Excellent work—cutting support tickets nearly in half is a meaningful impact! Let me capture this:

**Customer Portal Rebuild**
Led engineering team to rebuild 10-year-old portal that was slow and generating 200 support tickets per week. Used React and AWS with full technical authority. Reduced support tickets to 110/week.

Does that capture it? Do you have another achievement you'd like to share?

captured_moments.title: Customer Portal Rebuild
captured_moments.rawNotes: Led engineering team to rebuild 10-year-old customer portal that was slow and generating 200 support tickets per week. Had full technical decision authority. Used React and AWS. Result was tickets reduced to 110/week.

endpoints.name: CONTINUE - Guide to end when 3-5 moments captured
endpoints.description: When we have 3-5 moments, AI gently suggests ending to develop one into full story

Great work, Sarah! You've identified 3 strong achievements from your career:

1. **Customer Portal Rebuild** - Led team to rebuild slow legacy portal, cutting support tickets from 200/week to 110/week
2. **Database Migration to Cloud** - Architected zero-downtime migration that reduced costs 40% and improved performance 60%
